method: How the KM were worked out
Leg 1 - Outbound
Road distance from the loading point to the destination. For multi-drop routes it is the sum of every drop-to-drop leg, in the drive order shown in "Stops".
Leg 2 - Return
Road distance from the last drop back to the loading point.
Total
Leg 1 + Leg 2 (formula, so editing a blue KM cell updates the total).
KM Source

"Road-routed (OpenStreetMap)" = real driving distance from the OSRM routing engine. "Estimated (calibrated)" = straight-line distance x a road factor tuned against real OSRM results (e.g. Lagos-Ibadan 123.5, Lagos-Abuja 740, Lagos-Kano 984, Keffi-Ogere 729, Isolo-Maiduguri 1,557 km). Trips from the South-West to the South-South/South-East are measured via Benin City. Estimated figures are typically within about 5-10% of Google Maps; they will be replaced with road-routed figures once router.project-osrm.org is allowed in network settings.
Routing fix (multi-drop)
Every multi-drop route was re-sequenced into the shortest loop from the loading point and back. Where the order changed, the Notes column shows how many km the original written order would have cost.
Spellings

Destination names were corrected to their standard spelling (see "Spelling Corrections"). Where a state was given instead of a town, the state capital was used and named in brackets, e.g. "Imo State (Owerri)".
State and Region

Destination State is taken from the corrected town, not from the original sheet (which had errors such as Ibadan = Edo, Ekpoma = Delta, Abakaliki = "Ebo", Koko = "Bin Yauri"). Region uses Nigeria's six geopolitical zones.
Delivery type
Internal = destination in the same state as the loading point; these are mapped to your route zones (Internal Zones / Zone Areas sheets). Interstate = everything else.
Internal zones

KM per zone is given to the zone centre and to the far end of the zone, from each depot. Lagos zones are measured from all five Lagos loading points. Kano has no loading point in your list, so Kano zones are measured from Kano city centre - replace with your Kano hub when known.
3PL rate cards
Yellow cells are for you to enter the per-trip rate each 3rd-party vendor charges for 20FT, 25FT, 40FT, Crane, Hiab, Flatbed and Forklift trucks, for every internal zone and interstate lane.
Port Harcourt & Abuja rows
Hiab rows list JMG Gbagada as the loading point but the client main location is Port Harcourt / Abuja, so they are measured from Port Harcourt and Abuja city.
Not found (yellow rows)
IKM, Dembal, Nigerian Gas (Lagos) and Jega (Abuja local list) could not be located; Karame-City (Orca) was measured from Apapa as a stand-in. Send the exact addresses and they will be filled in.
Assumed locations
Kpoko = Okpoko (Onitsha); Ijebu Osas = Ijebu-Ososa; Lara (Ogun) = Ilara, Yewa North; Rumukpakolosi = Rumuokwurusi; Delta-direct = Asaba.
